description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'EmployeeProfilePictureController' which extends a base controller to manage employee profile pictures. It includes a pre-render method to set up Vue components and permissions based on request data.

classes.name: EmployeeProfilePictureController
classes.description: Controller class for handling employee profile picture operations, extending BaseViewEmployeeController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component with employee data and permissions before rendering, based on the request's empNumber attribute.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the list of data groups required for capability permission checks, here ['photograph'].
